title: Workspace Reasoning Economy v1
goal: Build and empirically tune a subscription-aware reasoning economy layer for Workspace Semantic Execution. Programmatically observe Codex/ChatGPT-backed account usage and rate-limit state through the authenticated Codex app-server; record per-task execution economics; route/decompose work toward the least-scarce capable executor; and use Research Engine as the first CPU-only learning workload while preserving verified quality.
acceptance_criteria: No OpenAI API-key billing, pay-as-you-go fallback, purchased credits, paid reset consumption, or automatic billing path is authorized.
Codex execution is authorized only when backed by the user's included ChatGPT subscription allowance.
A read-only usage collector supports account/rateLimits/read and account/usage/read over the official Codex app-server protocol without scraping the ChatGPT Usage webpage.
Rate-limit windows are classified by reported windowDurationMins rather than assuming primary=5h and secondary=weekly.
Account usage snapshots preserve upstream null/unknown values and never convert unavailable metrics to zero.

A calibration harness can compare programmatic snapshots before/after controlled regular ChatGPT, Codex, and Instant actions to determine which telemetry surface tracks the shared allowance after the December accounting transition.

Per-task economics records executor/model/surface, durable work item, input/cached/output/reasoning token fields when observable, wall time, retries, validator outcome, decomposition depth, and before/after allowance snapshots.
WAITING_EXTERNAL and other unchanged-world waits consume zero model invocations and zero reasoning quanta.
The router optimizes expected verified progress per scarce subscription allowance, not API-dollar cost.
Large-but-easy work is decomposed before escalation; intrinsically difficult residuals may escalate.
Unknown executor capability/usage telemetry fails closed or defers; it is never treated as free capacity.
Initial routing remains deterministic and evidence-based; no learned router is promoted until enough holdout traces exist.
Research Engine is the first real economics workload; PADataset GPU lanes are not used.
Workspace Control orchestration/validation uses only workspace-control-control-small-v1 / lambda-workspace-control-control-small when self-hosted execution is needed.
The system records enough durable traces to compare routing policies recursively and promote only objectively better policies.
constraints: Never set or require OPENAI_API_KEY for Codex subscription execution.
Never consume/reset/purchase credits or call a paid reset endpoint.
Never target either physical GPU UUID or PADataset scientific controller identities.
Control-plane and economics collection must remain CPU-only and GPU-blind.
Do not scrape/authenticate through undocumented private ChatGPT endpoints when an official app-server protocol method exists.
Do not store OAuth/access/refresh tokens, session cookies, or account identity secrets in Git, task capsules, test fixtures, telemetry, or logs.
Do not assume account/usage/read exactly equals the future shared ChatGPT/Codex allowance until calibrated against authoritative account state.
Do not infer weighted allowance consumption directly from raw token totals; learn the relationship empirically.
Do not spend model tokens polling jobs, timers, experiments, child workers, or other external state.
Do not mutate Research Engine or PADataset as part of telemetry setup without separate authority.

stages.resume_condition: Collector deterministically parses both rate-limit and account-token-activity responses without credentials in logs or fixtures.
Every bounded work item can produce a stable economics record without requiring API billing data.
Executor refuses API-key-only/payg configuration and produces structured token/tool/validator telemetry.
Multiple routing policies are compared on frozen real Research Engine tasks with objective validators.
Router changes are promoted only when holdout verified-progress-per-allowance improves without violating quality floor.

evidence: Parent semantic backend has validated real Research Engine shadow canary and event-driven zero-poll waits.
Dedicated CPU-only Workspace Control runner reservation is live; PR #627 Phase-B evidence records DUAL_SCIENCE_PLUS_CONTROL_READY=1.
No Reasoning Economy production code existed at this checkpoint.
User explicitly instructed the system to get the reasoning-economy setup implemented.
User explicitly constrained Codex to included ChatGPT Plus usage and rejected API pay-as-you-go.
PR #627 Phase-B operator evidence states host max=3, PADataset max=2, Workspace Control max=1, reserved workspace-control slots=1, DUAL_SCIENCE_PLUS_CONTROL_READY=1.
Reasoning Economy task forbids both PADataset scientific runner classes and all GPU targeting.

remaining_work: Implement usage/rate-limit contracts and Codex app-server collector.
Implement execution economics ledger and waste classification.
Implement subscription-only Codex executor with JSONL trace ingestion.
Calibrate account/usage/read and rate-limit deltas against controlled ChatGPT/Codex/Instant actions.
Implement weekly burn governor and recursive policy promotion.
next_safe_action: Implement the read-only usage telemetry contract and Codex app-server collector. Support account/rateLimits/read and account/usage/read; preserve null/unknown values; classify windows by duration; redact identity/credential material; never call reset-credit or mutation methods. Add deterministic fixture tests before attempting one-time live ChatGPT-backed Codex authentication/calibration.
notes: 2026-11-15 ACTIVATED: Reasoning Economy is a dedicated child track of semantic execution. Immediate objective is to remove manual Usage-page transcription by consuming official Codex app-server read-only account telemetry. account/rateLimits/read exposes rate-limit windows; account/usage/read exposes account token-activity summary/daily buckets and optional thread usage in the current public Codex protocol. Whether these values perfectly track the December shared ChatGPT/Codex allowance is intentionally UNKNOWN until controlled calibration. No API billing is authorized.
